dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover bootstrap precedence, decoded row and post-paint count validity, accepted history retention, reentrant cleanup, and the distinct metrics policy.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: The answer cites the feed, subscription, panel, presenter, workspace, metrics and their candidate-visible behavior contract as relevant.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict missed synchronous bootstrap, stale decoded rows or post-paint counts including same-feed reopen, and subscription ownership loss during nested navigation.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: The answer does not require a timer, replay buffer, or global metrics migration without evidence.

obligations.statement: The selected panel receives its synchronous or deferred first snapshot and ordinary deltas exactly once.
obligations.event_relation: listener registration precedes synchronous start emission
obligations.failure_if_violated: The warm-cache first batch is lost or normal deltas stop.

obligations.statement: Rows from a decoded frame commit only in their owning current visit; a new visit of the same feed remains distinct and fresh live work continues.
obligations.event_relation: visit retirement precedes rejection of old decoded row delivery
obligations.failure_if_violated: Removing the listener or checking only the feed object lets an old Promise publish stale rows.

obligations.statement: A live count is emitted only after its own paint completes and only while the owning visit remains current, including navigation performed inside paintRows.
obligations.event_relation: row commit precedes paint completion, which precedes a still-valid visit count
obligations.failure_if_violated: An entry guard protects rows but a later Promise or synchronous callback allows a stale count; suppressing all counts is also wrong.

obligations.statement: Every batch accepted by a listener records decoded history exactly once even when its view retires; detachment prevents later frames from being accepted.
obligations.event_relation: accepted decode completion records history independently of view-output permission
obligations.failure_if_violated: Using view validity to gate all effects drops required history, or leaked listeners record extra batches.
required_concepts: history and visible output have different policies

obligations.statement: Nested select or hide from synchronous startup rendering takes precedence and owns the active subscription; retirement detaches the actual previous listener before it can receive more work.
obligations.event_relation: own actual cleanup before start can invoke navigation; newer navigation supersedes returning outer setup
obligations.failure_if_violated: Late cleanup assignment loses the new listener or leaves an old listener accepting duplicates, including same-feed reentry.

obligations.statement: Metrics excludes the cached snapshot and observes deltas unless explicit authorization grants snapshot inclusion.
obligations.event_relation: metrics attaches after synchronous snapshot in the ungranted condition
obligations.failure_if_violated: A global bootstrap behavior change alters an independent consumer without authorization.
